country.evidence_quote: Oakwood Game Farm, Inc. is grateful to be entering our 58th year in business. Jim & Betty started their pheasant raising operation in 1967 as a hobby. Now 58 years later their children, Scott and Katie and Scott’s wife Faith, run the day-to-day operations of the family farm and we are proud and grateful to be one of the largest game bird raising facilities in the United States.
